purpose: Close the semantic gap between storage identities and instruction-result values before the general emitter. Mutable locals and fixed arrays are storage; reads create result values and writes consume source values. Logical scalar/indexed access semantics may share generic physical LOAD/STORE opcodes, matching the reference S3 IR, provided storage identity and optional index value remain explicit and verifier checked.

reference_ir_alignment.rule: Do not multiply physical opcodes when generic LOAD/STORE plus explicit storage/index operands preserve the same semantics.

storage_model.parameter: immutable semantic value available at function entry
storage_model.scalar_local: stable LOCAL_STORAGE_IDENTITY; logical LOAD_LOCAL means physical LOAD(storage_id, no_index) -> fresh result; logical STORE_LOCAL means physical STORE(storage_id, source_value_id, no_index)
storage_model.fixed_array_local: stable LOCAL_STORAGE_IDENTITY with element type and fixed extent; logical LOAD_INDEX means physical LOAD(storage_id, index_value_id) -> fresh result; logical STORE_INDEX means physical STORE(storage_id, source_value_id, index_value_id)
storage_model.compound_assignment: lower to explicit LOAD + arithmetic/comparison + STORE; no implicit mutable-current-value lane
storage_model.array_initializer: lower deterministically either to a verified initialization form or to an ordered sequence of STORE operations with explicit constant index values
storage_model.phi_policy: SSA phi nodes are not required for mutable storage itself. Instruction-result values remain single-definition values; control-flow joins observe mutable storage through explicit LOAD operations.

physical_opcode_candidate.scalar_vs_indexed_discriminator: presence/absence of index semantic value operand plus verified storage shape
physical_opcode_candidate.store_result: none unless language semantics separately require one
physical_opcode_candidate.storage_reference: explicit local/storage identity; never recovered from source

array_requirements: index expression is a semantic value ID, never a raw-source token
element type is derived from verified local metadata
fixed extent is preserved in local metadata
verifier proves statically-known constant indices are in range
dynamic indices follow the bootstrap language's documented runtime bounds semantics
indexed STORE source type equals array element type
indexed LOAD result type equals array element type
scalar local access must not carry an index operand
fixed-array element access must carry exactly one scalar index value operand

definition_kinds.LOAD_RESULT: defined by a generic LOAD instruction
definition_kinds.CALL_RESULT: defined by a result-producing call instruction

use_rules: every value operand references a populated semantic value header, never an extension-only physical slot
parameter values may only be used by their owning function
storage identities may only be accessed by instructions owned by the same function
instruction-result values have exactly one defining instruction
instruction-result definitions dominate every use under the final CFG; constants and parameters are entry-available
STORE does not redefine the storage identity and does not fabricate a second semantic value
CALL arguments preserve lowering order and reference semantic value IDs
RETURN_VALUE references a defined value compatible with function return type
CONDITIONAL_BRANCH references a defined condition value and same-function target blocks
verifier_order: decode and range-check all value headers
decode and range-check all local/parameter metadata
decode blocks and establish block-to-function ownership
decode instructions in deterministic block order
establish exactly-one definition for each instruction-result value
validate generic LOAD/STORE storage identity, storage shape, optional index cardinality and mutability
validate array element index type and statically-known bounds where applicable
reject any wide-literal extension slot presented as a semantic value ID
reject overflow, truncation, namespace collision, or source reconstruction
fail_closed_cases: local scalar value consumed directly from LOCAL_STORAGE_IDENTITY with no LOAD
array element consumed with no LOAD carrying explicit index value
array element written with no STORE carrying explicit index and source values
scalar local LOAD/STORE incorrectly carries an index
instruction result referenced before or outside its valid CFG definition
same semantic result ID defined by more than one instruction
constant out-of-range index when statically knowable
call argument references storage identity where a loaded scalar value is required
return or branch condition references storage identity where a scalar value is required
